title: Adoptado Almapa puriynin
intro: Normas societales nisqakuna kamachikusqan tiempopin, huk sapan runaqa saminchasqa wasi ukhupi sinchita t’ikrakurqan. Willakuyninkuqa, munakuypa watakuyninwan, Diospa kamachikuyninwan ima riqsichisqa, ñawpaq tradicionkuna p’akikuyninta, mosoq chanin kamachikuykunata churakuynintapas rikuchin. Kay willakuymi qawachin chiqap kaqpa ancha allin kayninta convencionmanta hinaspa Allahpa kamachikuyninkunapa qipanpi yachay kasqanmanta.
clues: Huk kutinmi preso karqani, ichaqa Diospa arreglo ruwasqanwanmi mosoq wasita familiatapas tarirqani.
Ancha munasqa karqani, chaymi familiay biológico nisqamanta hinaspa adoptasqa guardiaymanta akllakuyta quwaptinku, chay qipa kaqwan qipakuyta akllakurqani.
Huk kutinmi sutiyqa adoptasqa guardiaywan tupachisqa karqan, chay ruwayqa llaqtaypin común karqan.
Ñuqallam kani chay qipa Profetapa compañeron, paypa sutinmi sutillata Allahpa Quranpi riman.
Huk noble warmiwanmi casarakurqani, payqa Profetaq primonmi karqan, ichaqa manan casarakuyniykuqa unaypaqchu karqan.
Divorciakusqay qhepamanmi kikin Allah kamachirqan ñawpaq warmiy Profetawan casarakunanpaq, chhaynapin adoptacionmanta ñawpaq costumbre mana valeqman tukupurqan.

outcome.label: Tukusqa
options: Ñawpaq islam nisqa ‘adoptado churikunata biológico churikuna nispa waqyay’ nisqa ruway chinkachiy.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
